suggest.description: Propose a plan and artifacts; do not write files.

review.description: Write changes only after a named checkpoint is approved.

autofix.description: Apply only the safe set without approval.

safeSet: formatting and import cleanup inside a generated slice
documentation and ADR updates with no behavior change
regenerating files whose spec did not change
adding contract tests that do not change behavior
neverAutofix: Neo4j constraints, indexes, or destructive migrations
data deletion or destructive pipeline apply
